title: Inside the 2026 National Retail Federation conference in New York City, where integrating AI into retail businesses was the overarching theme on the expo floor (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Inside the 2026 National Retail Federation conference in New York City, where integrating AI into retail businesses was the overarching theme on the expo floor — Stores of all kinds are using artificial intelligence to sell everything from luxury handbags to hay for horses.
